intro: Captain Pentigast believes whichever centaur clan wins the wars of Desolace will spill out and threaten the Alliance strongholds. To learn how to beat them, Pentigast wants an alliance with one clan: fight the Gelkis, win over the Magram, and speak with Warug.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Desolace is a land at war. The centaurs wage war with each other, and we believe the victor among them will spill out and threaten our strongholds. That, we cannot allow

We must learn how to beat the centaurs, and to do that... We must ally with one of the clans. The Magram centaurs war with the Gelkis. If you fight the Gelkis then the Magram might consider an alliance.
Earn the favor of the Magrams then speak with Warug, in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will go now, or the Magram will crush you! To be our friend, you must kill Gelkis.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Many Gelkis fall to you. I like that. Maybe you can do more things I like. Maybe you and the Magram can be friends.
